items.title: Rome Odunze: Three catches in Week 5 loss
items.text:
Odunze brought in three of nine targets for 40 yards in the Bears' 31-7 loss to the Packers on Sunday. He also lost a fumble.

items.title: Luther Burden: Leads pass catchers in loss
items.text:
Burden secured four of six targets for 47 yards and rushed four times for two yards in the Bears' 31-7 loss to the Packers on Sunday.

items.title: Alvin Kamara: Limited to five touches Sunday
items.text:
Kamara rushed three times for 12 yards and brought in both targets for minus-6 yards in the Saints' 23-13 loss to the Vikings on Sunday.

items.title: Cam Skattebo: Loses key fumble in Week 5 tie
items.text:
Skattebo rushed 13 times for 59 yards and caught two of three targets for 12 yards in Sunday's 27-27 tie against the Commanders. He also lost a fumble.

        Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

items.title: Jayden Daniels: Two rushing TDs in return
items.text:
Daniels (elbow) completed 17 of 25 passes for 199 yards, no touchdowns and no interceptions while rushing nine times for 103 yards and two touchdowns in Sunday's 27-27 tie against the Giants. He also threw a successful two-point conversion.
